name: Taira Clinic
description: Taira Clinic is a WordPress theme for a vestibular and balance clinic, a physiotherapy or falls-prevention practice. A split hero with a photograph on the left and a stepped four-line headline beside it, a finder box docked on the photo corner, a peeking row of plate cards with previous/next buttons for the symptoms people arrive with, a narrative with a slowly drifting photograph, a three-row method, one case and two flat booking blocks, in Figtree and Manrope on white with slate and steel blue.

fonts.role: display: headings, the wordmark, labels, figures and booking blocks (variable 300-900, Latin subset)
